title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: An adult male grey seal in the water off the Isle of May, Scotland. Grey seals can range hundreds of kilometres from coastal haulouts while on foraging trips, frequently crossing international maritime borders. Full details are available in the article by Carter et al., https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2664.70236. Photo: © Dr Kelly J Robinson.
